```{r setup}
df_to_html <- function(
    input_data,
    output_html_path,
    page_title,
    encoding = "UTF-8") {

  # Determine if input_data is a file path or a data frame
  if (base::is.character(input_data) && base::file.exists(input_data)) {
    # If it's a file path, read the CSV
    data_to_convert <- readr::read_csv(
      input_data,
      locale = readr::locale(encoding = encoding)
    )
    base::message("Input is a CSV file. Reading data from: ", input_data)
  } else if (base::is.data.frame(input_data)) {
    # If it's a data frame, use it directly
    data_to_convert <- input_data
    base::message("Input is a data frame. Converting directly.")
  } else {
    base::stop(
      "Invalid 'input_data'. Must be a valid CSV file path or a data frame."
    )
  }

  # 2. Convert the data frame to an HTML table string
  html_table_string <- knitr::kable(data_to_convert, format = "html")

  # 3. Build the complete HTML page and save it
  html_doc <- htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::tags$head(
      # Ensure HTML file also declares the correct charset
      htmltools::tags$meta(charset = encoding),
      htmltools::tags$title(page_title),
      htmltools::tags$style(
        "table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: sans-serif; }",
        "th, td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px; text-align: left; }",
        "th { background-color: #f2f2f2; }"
      )
    ),
    htmltools::tags$body(
      htmltools::tags$h1(page_title),
      htmltools::HTML(html_table_string)
    )
  )

  htmltools::save_html(html_doc, file = output_html_path)

  base::cat(base::paste0(
    "Data successfully saved to HTML file: ",
    output_html_path,
    "\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Example 1: For "result_recovery.csv"
df_to_html(
  input_data = "../OUTPUT/result_recovery.csv",
  output_html_path = "../OUTPUT/result_recovery.html",
  page_title = "Recovery",
  encoding = "UTF-8" # Or "GBK", "CP936" if UTF-8 causes issues
)

# Example 2: For "result_comparison.csv"
df_to_html(
  input_data = "../OUTPUT/result_comparison.csv",
  output_html_path = "../OUTPUT/result_comparison.html",
  page_title = "Comparison",
  encoding = "UTF-8" # Or "GBK", "CP936"
)
```

```{r}
binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
  mode = "replay",
  data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_Exp2,
  id = 1,
  eta = 0.5, tau = 0.5,
  n_params = 2, n_trials = 360
)

df_to_html(
  input_data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_Exp2 %>% dplyr::filter(Subject == 1),
  output_html_path = "../DATA/binaryRL_data.html",
  page_title = "Example Data",
  encoding = "UTF-8" # Or "GBK", "CP936"
)

df_to_html(
  input_data = binaryRL.res[[1]],
  output_html_path = "../DATA/binaryRL_result.html",
  page_title = "Example Result",
  encoding = "UTF-8" # Or "GBK", "CP936"
)
```
